basics.name: AHM Zafir Hasan
basics.title: Junior Software Engineer · .NET 9 & Full-Stack Specialist
basics.summary: Passionate and analytical aspiring Software Developer focused on building reliable, scalable, and user-centric software solutions. Developing expertise in full-stack .NET development, RESTful APIs, database engineering, and modern frontend technologies through the IsDB-BISEW IT Scholarship Programme. Driven by continuous learning, emerging technologies, and solving real-world problems through software engineering, with a strong commitment to professional growth and meaningful contributions to technology-driven teams.

experience.company: IsDB-BISEW IT Scholarship Programme | Star Computer Systems Limited
experience.role: Enterprise Systems Analysis & Design with C# .NET (WADA / ESAD-CS)
highlights: Completed an intensive, full-time 9-month professional software engineering curriculum (Trainee ID: 1294926, Round 70), dedicating 1,000+ hours to enterprise software development.
Built and deployed 8+ full-stack and multi-tier applications across desktop, web, and cloud-ready architectures utilizing C#, ASP.NET Core (.NET 9), EF Core, SQL Server, React 19, and Angular.
Served as backend and database lead on the capstone Skill-Commerce hyperlocal skilled-worker marketplace platform.
Analyzed business KPIs, regional market trends, and product performance data across regional distribution networks.
Collaborated with cross-functional commercial teams to evaluate structured market research and present actionable insights.

experience.company: Academic Mentorship & Independent Tech Services, Dhaka
experience.role: HSC ICT Instructor & Hardware Systems Specialist
highlights: Instructed college students in the national NCTB HSC ICT curriculum across multiple academic sessions (C programming syntax, relational SQL database structures, Boolean algebra & digital gates, and web design foundations).

Diagnosed, repaired, upgraded, and maintained desktop computers and laptop workstations at component levels, drawing on lifelong hardware expertise developed through PC gaming and extensive system builds.
Executed component troubleshooting, motherboard diagnostics, thermal paste replacement, hardware stress testing, and BIOS/UEFI restorations.

education.degree: Professional Diploma in Enterprise Systems Development (C# .NET)
highlights: Comprehensive enterprise curriculum covering C# OOP, SQL Server & T-SQL, ASP.NET Core (.NET 9), EF Core, React 19, Angular, and RESTful APIs.

education.degree: Bachelor of Social Sciences (B.S.S. Hons) in Economics
highlights: Quantitative foundation in Econometrics, Mathematical Statistics, and Analytical Data Modeling.
Completed secondary education in Science with focused coursework in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

projects.name: Candela — HSC Physics & Math Mobile App
projects.description: Educational mobile application published on Google Play with 10,000+ active downloads and 4.6★ rating across 570+ reviews, delivering structured study guides for HSC Physics and Mathematics.
highlights: Co-developed a high-impact mobile education application published on the Google Play Store, achieving 10,000+ active installs and a 4.6★ rating across 570+ student reviews.
Engineered fluid, state-managed mobile UI screens using Flutter & Dart, structured offline formula indexation, and optimized navigation workflows.
Leveraged PostgreSQL for structured relational persistence of academic modules and chapter-by-chapter curriculum resources.

projects.name: ProductCatalogSPA & Product Management System
projects.description: High-throughput RESTful Web API with single-controller CRUD routing, normalized Category-Product-Brand relations, and dual React 19 and Angular SPA clients.
highlights: Architected a high-throughput RESTful Web API with single-controller CRUD routing, normalized database relations (Category-Product-Brand), and automated database seeding (EnsureCreated()).

Engineered dual Single Page Application clients: an Angular client supporting dynamic brand row insertions with cascading deletes, and a React 19 client featuring dual Table and Card/Grid view modes with instant search and category filtering.
Implemented secure multipart/form-data image streaming with GUID file naming to prevent server disk collisions, coupled with zero-latency client-side thumbnail previews and JWT authentication.

projects.name: TechNova — Real-Time Tech Hardware E-Commerce
projects.description: Hardware e-commerce platform featuring duplex real-time inventory updates via WebSockets, automated email notifications, and dynamic QR Code generation.
highlights: Developed a full-stack e-commerce hardware store featuring product catalog navigation, shopping cart sessions, dynamic checkout, and order status tracking.
Integrated bi-directional real-time communication via WebSockets (ws) to push live inventory levels and immediate order updates without client polling.
Built automated checkout flows supporting cash-on-delivery, transactional email notifications via Nodemailer, and dynamic QR Code generation for invoice retrieval and package delivery tracking.

projects.name: Employee Master-Details Enterprise Management
projects.description: Master-detail enterprise system resolving multipart payload constraints by combining binary image streams with client-serialized JSON strings.
highlights: Engineered a robust master-detail persistence system resolving complex multipart HTTP payloads by combining binary image streams with client-serialized JSON strings (EXperiencesString).
Designed and implemented the transactional Wipe & Re-insert pattern in the HTTP PUT endpoint to synchronize dynamic child collections without orphaned database records.
Implemented memory-safe frontend state management with crypto.randomUUID() for stable virtual DOM keys and URL.revokeObjectURL() to eliminate client memory leaks during image uploads.

projects.name: Skill-Commerce Booking Marketplace
projects.description: Hyperlocal service marketplace platform connecting clients with skilled technicians; served as backend and database lead designing booking orchestration APIs.
highlights: Served as backend and database lead on team capstone designing RESTful API architecture for customer bookings, provider scheduling, and profile management.
Designed 15+ normalized REST API endpoints and data contracts for booking lifecycles and service provider verification.
Led Git/GitHub team sprint branching workflows, pull request reviews, and daily Agile standups.

projects.name: Supply Chain & Category-Product RESTful Web API (ShortAPI)
projects.description: Enterprise REST API secured by OWIN OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens with custom resource owner password credentials validation and custom Multipart MediaTypeFormatter.
highlights: Built an enterprise REST API secured by OWIN OAuth 2.0 token authentication with custom resource owner password credentials validation.
Authored a custom MultipartFormatter : MediaTypeFormatter to bind multi-part HTTP requests containing entity models and raw image byte arrays in a single round-trip.
Configured role-based security (Admin vs. User) and validated API reliability through extensive Postman test suites.

projects.name: Power Plant Operations Reporting Database
projects.description: Industrial 3NF relational schema across 12+ tables modeling monthly power generation metrics, plant operations, and fuel types from industrial records.
highlights: Designed a normalized 3NF relational database schema across 12+ tables modeling monthly power generation metrics, plant operations, and fuel types based on real-world industrial specifications.
Transformed raw operational spreadsheets into structured SQL tables, enforcing primary/foreign keys and referential integrity for scalable analytical reporting.
